products.product_description: Recchiuti Key Lime Apples; Net Wt: 4 oz. Crispy slices of Granny-Smith Apples in Semi-sweet chocolate. Ingredient: Dark chocolate (cocoa beans, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lechthin (emulsifier), natural vanilla extract), apple, sugar, lime. CONTAINS: Soy Also has sticker: May Contain Dairy Made on equipment also shared with soy, milk, wheat, eggs, peanuts and tree nuts. Handmade by Recchiuti Confections, San Francisco, CA
products.reason_for_recall: FDA sampling found high levels of Milk Protein in one lot of Dark Chocolate Covered Key Lime Apples.
